notes: STUDENT-15's load budget, checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs after every npm run build. studentBootBaselineKB is the first-load JavaScript, gzipped (zlib's default level), of a vite build --manifest of 5618298, the commit the student lane started from, measured by the same script. studentCssBaselineKB is the first-load CSS (the stylesheets of the entry and its static imports, KaTeX's included), gzipped the same way on the same build of 5618298; studentCssDeltaKB 0 holds this lane's CSS to no net growth (STUDENT-15). lazyOnly modules must never be in the first load. chunkMaxKB holds every chunk loaded on demand; the entry chunk is DURABLE-11's to split (the teaching content per topic), and its own budget.json replaces this file's notes when that lane merges.
